'''Mimoza Hafizi''' (born 1962) is an Albanian politician and physicist who is a former member of the [[Assembly of the Republic of Albania]] for the [[Libra Party (Albania)|LIBRA Party]]. She has been representing the [[Socialist Party of Albania|Socialist Party]] from 2013 until 2016. In October 2016, together with [[Ben Blushi]], she created LIBRA.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tiranaecho.com/latest-news/albanian-pms-former-friend-and-rebel-mp-ben-blushi-quits-the-socialist-party/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161118101150/http://www.tiranaecho.com/latest-news/albanian-pms-former-friend-and-rebel-mp-ben-blushi-quits-the-socialist-party/|url-status=usurped|archive-date=November 18, 2016|title=Albanian PM's former friend and rebel MP Ben Blushi quits the Socialist Party – Tirana Echo – South East Europe from Tirana|website=www.tiranaecho.com|date=October 2016|accessdate=23 March 2018}}</ref> She failed to win a second mandate on the [[Albanian parliamentary election, 2017|2017 election]].

She was born on 20 February 1962 in [[Shkodër]]. She graduated from the [[University of Tirana]] in Physics and is a well known astrophysicist in the country. She later continued her doctoral studies in France, in the [[École Normale Supérieure]] in Paris.
She is a prominent figure, a well known academic and an MP since 2013 for the [[Shkodër County]].

==Education==
* Doctorate in Theoretical Physics from the Paris 7 University, France (1995)
* Masters of Theoretical Physics from the Paris 7 University, France (1991)
* Graduate of Advanced Physics from the University of Tirana, Faculty of Natural Sciences (1875)
* Associated professor of Physics (2000)
